rationale: Repairs the paint/raster performance regression introduced by the angled 2.5D presentation in the current 1.85.3 beta line; retains the accepted design and is not a new user feature or a repair of the preceding stable.

summary.ru: Ускорено панорамирование 2.5D без отключения масок подписей, света и объёмной мебели.
summary.en: Faster 2.5D panning without disabling label masks, lighting or volume furniture.
